goal: ThermalRouter in susi-gemi is an isolated in-memory state tracker with no explicit unknown telemetry state handling or operator limits, unintegrated with host telemetry or model placement, and lacks mechanisms to throttle or queue local-only work under simulated pressure instead of rerouting to cloud. Acceptance requires a test that exercises the production path, not the module in isolation: this task was filed with the vector's mastery test as its acceptance, and that test passes today because the module already satisfies its own semantics - which is why the task could be closed without the integration it asks for. The named test does not exist yet, and is the work.
title: Integrate thermal and power limits into placement with unknown states and local-only throttling
